title: D3.js
summary: Data diagrams printed on a cream comic panel: flat primary colours with Ben-Day shading, thick ink outlines and hard shadows, titles shouted in inked lettering with the unit in a yellow caption box. Bars punch out and overshoot, numbers count up, bursts pop on the value that matters. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float them over footage as a paper sheet.
usage: {"piece": "d3/bar-chart", "props": {"title": "…", "unit": "…", "items": [{"label": "A", "value": 3}]}}. Every label, number and colour is a prop; "accent" picks the panel colour (paper by default). Files: library/themes/comic/d3/pieces/ (_card.js is the shared card, not a piece).

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Halftone-shaded bars shoot up from an ink baseline and overshoot; a burst pops behind the tallest.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A thick inked trend line drawn left to right over halftone, with a speech balloon calling out the last value.

items.name: Donut
items.description: Slices sweep round an inked ring, the biggest jumps out and its share is shouted in the hole, with a key beside it.

items.name: Ranking
items.description: A league table: numbered discs pop, slabs punch out to the right and values count up at their tips.

items.name: Versus
items.description: A red panel and a blue panel whip in from each side with counting numbers and a VS burst on the seam.

items.name: Funnel
items.description: Inked slabs drop into a funnel, each with the share that is left shouted inside and the count beside it.

items.name: Gauge
items.description: A three-zone dial; the needle whips round, overshoots and quivers on the reading, and a caption names the zone.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: An ink line runs across the panel while discs, caption boxes and shouted dates pop above and below it in turn.

items.name: Steps
items.description: A how-to as a page of numbered, crooked colour panels that pop on in reading order.

items.name: Hub and spokes
items.description: A burst in the middle with labelled slabs popping out around it on ink lines: one thing feeding many.

items.name: Pictogram
items.description: Rows of inked figures pop on, the counted ones in colour and bouncing, with “7 out of 10” shouted underneath.

items.name: Big number
items.description: Zoom lines, a two-colour burst and one number counting up inside it, with a slab label and a balloon aside.
